voiceSummary: Ganges Securities Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The standalone Net Profit after tax for the half year was 356.41 lakhs, compared to 365.77 lakhs in the previous year. Total Revenue from Operations stood at 594.86 lakhs for the half year. The company reported Total Assets of 65,969.33 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. Earnings per equity share for the half year were 356. The financial results were reviewed by statutory auditors JKVS & Co.
